description: This file provides support for the FT_Outline type used to store glyph shapes in scalable font formats within the FreeType project. It includes function declarations for creating, transforming, rendering, and analyzing font outlines, as well as related enums and macros.

methods.name: FT_Outline_Decompose
methods.description: Walks over an outline to decompose it into segments and Bezier arcs, calling specified emitter functions.

methods.name: FT_Outline_New
methods.description: Creates a new outline of specified size with maximum points and contours.

methods.name: FT_Outline_Done
methods.description: Destroys an outline created with FT_Outline_New.

methods.name: FT_Outline_Check
methods.description: Checks the contents of an outline descriptor for consistency.

methods.name: FT_Outline_Get_CBox
methods.description: Returns the control box of an outline, enclosing all points including Bezier control points.

methods.name: FT_Outline_Translate
methods.description: Applies a translation offset to an outline's points.

methods.name: FT_Outline_Copy
methods.description: Copies one outline into another, assuming same size.

methods.name: FT_Outline_Transform
methods.description: Applies a 2x2 transformation matrix to an outline's points.

methods.name: FT_Outline_Reverse
methods.description: Reverses the drawing direction of an outline.

methods.name: FT_Outline_Get_Bitmap
methods.description: Renders an outline into a bitmap.

methods.name: FT_Outline_Render
methods.description: Renders an outline into a bitmap using current scan-convert parameters.

methods.name: FT_Outline_Get_Orientation
methods.description: Analyzes an outline to determine its contour orientation (clockwise or counter-clockwise).
